incidents.text: Nizar Al Rashdan (Jordan) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. Although the shot low to the middle of the goal isn't very precise, it ends up in the net.
Ramiz Zerrouki (Algeria) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
Vladimir Petkovic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Nabil Bentaleb comes on the pitch for Ramiz Zerrouki (Algeria).
Vladimir Petkovic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nadir Benbouali (Algeria) replacing Hicham Boudaoui.
Husam Abu Dahab (Jordan) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

Nadir Benbouali (Algeria) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Riyad Mahrez. His header bounced off the ground and went inside the left post behind the goalkeeper. It's 1:1.
The referee allows time for a substitution. Riyad Mahrez will be replaced by Anis Hadj Moussa (Algeria).
Jamal Sellami decides to make a substitution. Mahmoud Al Mardi will be replaced by Odeh Al Fakhouri (Jordan).
Goal! Amine Gouiri (Algeria) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
Jamal Sellami prepares a substitution. Mousa Tamari is replaced by Ali Azaizeh (Jordan).
Substitution. Mohammad Abu Hasheesh (Jordan) has come on for Mohannad Abu Taha.
Substitution. Rayan Ait-Nouri is replaced by Jaouen Hadjam (Algeria).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amine Gouiri departs the field of play to be replaced by Zineddine Belaid (Algeria).
Today's match ends for Husam Abu Dahab who will be replaced by Saleem Obaid (Jordan).
Jamal Sellami has decided to substitute Ali Olwan and he is replaced by Shararh (Jordan).
